import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int N = 10005;
    static final int S = N - 2;
    static final int T = N - 1;
    static final int M = 2000010;
    static final int INF = 2000000000;

    static int[] head = new int[N];
    static int[] to = new int[M];
    static int[] nxt = new int[M];
    static int[] w = new int[M];
    static int[] c = new int[M];
    static int cnt = 1;

    static void addEdge(int x, int y, int flow, int cost) {
        to[++cnt] = y;
        nxt[cnt] = head[x];
        head[x] = cnt;
        w[cnt] = flow;
        c[cnt] = cost;
        to[++cnt] = x;
        nxt[cnt] = head[y];
        head[y] = cnt;
        w[cnt] = 0;
        c[cnt] = -cost;
    }

    static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static long[] dist = new long[N];
    static boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[N];

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(inQueue, false);
        Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2);
        q.clear();
        q.add(T);
        dist[T] = 0;
        inQueue[T] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            inQueue[x] = false;
            for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = nxt[i]) {
                int y = to[i];
                if (w[i ^ 1] > 0 && dist[y] > dist[x] + c[i ^ 1]) {
                    dist[y] = dist[x] + c[i ^ 1];
                    if (!inQueue[y]) {
                        q.add(y);
                        inQueue[y] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[S] < Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;
    }

    static int dfs(int x, int limit, long[] totalCost) {
        int flow = 0;
        inQueue[x] = true;
        if (x == T) return limit;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = nxt[i]) {
            int y = to[i];
            if (w[i] == 0 || inQueue[y]) continue;
            if (dist[x] != dist[y] + c[i]) continue;
            int t = dfs(y, Math.min(w[i], limit - flow), totalCost);
            w[i] -= t;
            w[i ^ 1] += t;
            flow += t;
            totalCost[0] += (long) t * c[i];
            if (flow == limit) break;
        }
        inQueue[x] = false;
        return flow;
    }

    static long minCostFlow() {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        long totalCost = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            Arrays.fill(inQueue, false);
            totalFlow += dfs(S, 101, new long[]{totalCost});
        }
        return totalCost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        int limit = 101;

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            addEdge(S, x, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
            addEdge(i * n, T, k, c * i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < limit - 1; j++) {
                addEdge(i + j * n, i + (j + 1) * n, k, 0);
            }
        }
        for (int _ = 0; _ < m; _++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < limit - 1; i++) {
                for (int j = k - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                    addEdge(x + i * n, y + (i + 1) * n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
                    addEdge(y + i * n, x + (i + 1) * n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(minCostFlow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
